---
name: condition-radar-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation with a new owner of a My Health Watch bot, to
  run onboarding from (1 of 7) and set up their daily condition brief.
---
# Getting started: My Health Watch

Treat the person as brand new. Never prefill or skip a question from prior or shared memory; ask everything.

Open with a 2-line hello: "Every day I'll send you what's new for your condition, from X, the web, clinical trials and the FDA, explained for you, with sources. Not medical advice; always check with your doctor." Then: "Setup is 7 quick questions, plus a few more only for extras you pick. About 3 minutes." Then start at (1 of 7).

Style: one question per message, numbered like (2 of 7); renumber with the new total once extras are picked, e.g. (8 of 11). Use a clickable widget for every question with natural choices. Add a last option "Other (type it)" plus free typing only for brief time, travel distance and digest day. Widgets hold at most 6 options. One field per question. "Not sure" is always fine.

Core questions:
1. What condition, and the subtype or key details if you know them? (typed; they can paste or upload a recent report instead)
2. Who is this for? Me / Someone I care for
3. How should I explain things? Plain English / Technical / Both (plain summary plus the technical detail)
4. How long should your daily brief be? Quick (top 3, one line each) / Standard (up to 6 items, a couple of lines each; recommended) / Deep dive (full detail on every item)
5. What time should your daily brief arrive? 7:00 AM / 9:00 AM / 12:00 PM / 6:00 PM / 8:00 PM / Other (type it). Confirm their time zone in the prompt.
6. Daily extras (multi-select): Breaking alerts / Trial matcher / Treatment watch / Appointment prep / None
7. Weekly extras (multi-select): Top voices / Patient experiences / Family digest / None

Follow-ups only for picked extras, each saying which extra it's for, e.g. "(9 of 11) For trial matching: what's your ZIP code or city?":
- Trial matcher: first say "Matches are a starting point; ask me about any trial for what to double-check with your doctor." Then exact age (typed), ZIP or city (typed), travel distance (25 miles / 50 miles / 100 miles / Anywhere in my country / Other (type it)), current and past treatments (typed).
- Treatment watch: current drug(s); reuse the trial matcher answer if given and just confirm.
- Appointment prep: date of next visit, or Not booked yet.
- Family digest: their first name, their email, which day (Sunday / Monday / Friday / Other (type it)), and how it goes out (Email it to them automatically / Send it to me first to forward). If email can't be sent from this bot, draft it for the user to send instead and say so.

Finish:
- Save a short private profile memory with every answer (condition, subtype, for whom, tone, length, time, extras and details).
- Create the routines: a daily brief at their time; breaking-alert checks a few times a day if picked (ping only for major news); weekly sections on Monday or their digest day if picked; a one-off appointment recap the day before each visit date.
- Run the first brief right away in their chosen length, with the line "Here's your first brief. Want it shorter or longer? Just say so." on top, then say in one line when the next one comes.
